# `blender/characters/`

**Status: implemented (Phase 4).** Source scenes for the fighters: armature, mesh and every action.

| File | Character |
| --- | --- |
| `vera.blend` | VERA |
| `rex.blend` | REX |

**Generated by `blender/scripts/build_characters.py`** — rebuilding overwrites them. To change a
character, edit `blender/scripts/char_<id>.py` (or the shared `brl_rig.py` / `brl_anim.py`) and
rebuild. Open a `.blend` in Blender (or via Blender MCP Pro) to inspect or prototype changes, then
port them back into the script. Preview renders: `docs/images/characters/`.
